name: Gilded Sentinel
title: Orrery Plate Guard
biography: An ivory-and-gold construct keeps silent watch beneath broad shoulder plates. A single dark face slit brightens before its heavy fist falls.
weakness: Dodge the frontal fist, then counterattack during its heavy recovery.
origin: The Sunken Orrery, an original fictional PawTrail location

skills.name: Gilded Slam
skills.description: A heavy fist covers the forward wedge. Move around its side.
